knob: chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort, read by trtllm-serve's deepseek_v41 tokenizer (--custom_tokenizer deepseek_v41) in thinking mode only (chat_template_kwargs.thinking or enable_thinking true). It takes an integer 1-100, the checkpoint's names low/high/max (50/75/100), and OpenAI's level names placed on the same budget: minimal 25, low 50, medium 62, high 75, xhigh 87, max 100. Without a value it renders 75. The Chat route never passes the top-level reasoning_effort to it.

levels.off: chat mode (thinking false): no effort line
levels.max: Reasoning Effort: 100 (the model card's evaluation setting)

notes: pi sends only strings through $var (a number in thinkingLevelMap is not allowed), so the level names travel and the served tokenizer turns them into budgets. The checkpoint's own encoder knows only low/high/max and integers: a server without trtllm-serve's OpenAI-name table would reject minimal, medium and xhigh.
